solution.text:
During AB process is isochoric.

∴  ΔV = 0  ∴  W = 0

During BC, the process is isothermal.



∴  ΔT=0

∴W⁡=RT2lnV⁡2V⁡1

During CA, the process is isobaric. So, the pressure is constant.

∴  W = P(V1–V2)

But PV1= RT1

∴ P⁡ = RT 1 V⁡ 1 = RT 2 V⁡ 2 ∴ W⁡ = RT 1 V⁡ 1 V⁡ 1 - V⁡ 2 = RT 2 V⁡ 2 V⁡ 1 - V⁡ 2
